key_insight: DeepDOSReasoner predicts electronic and phonon density-of-states spectra from crystal structures while enforcing nonnegativity and total-state conservation.
engineering_relevance: Millisecond spectral predictions could accelerate materials screening, including photovoltaic chalcogenides, but do not directly establish solar-cell efficiency.
method: Map atomic structure to spectra with atom-to-energy source attention.
Refine normalized spectra using learned continuity-equation transport.
Screen candidate materials for rare valence-band gaps.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports the best accuracy among evaluated methods for both spectrum types and new DFT validation of an 8,106-material screen, confirming valence-band gaps in 25 of the top 50 candidates.
watch_item: DFT-validated spectral predictions still require experimental and device-level validation before use in solar-cell design.
paper_title: DeepDOSReasoner: Physics-Grounded Reasoning for Density-of-States Prediction and Materials Discovery
